name: Onesa

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands, indigo over orange, with a white five-pointed star in the upper hoist.
flag.note: Invented for the demo (2026-11-12) to replace the real Lao flag in the journey pictures; it is meant to resemble no real country's flag. Drawn in docs/images/moment-j4-crossing-back.jpg.

code.note: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 user-assigned code (range XAA to XZZ), so it can never name a real country. On the GDHCN DEV network XXK is an onboarded test participant (WorldHealthOrganization/tng-participants-dev XXK/); its keys are test keys, not any ministry's.

description: A fictional country: the traveller's home. Its health system registers people, keeps their lifelong record, verifies certificates issued abroad, and shares the record back out as a Verifiable Health Link.

places.Lomaru: the capital; Lomaru District Health Center is the family's home clinic (J3)
places.Village 04: where the community health worker finds the family (J2)
places.Tanavu: a coastal town; the pilgrim Kamal's home and his GP's clinic (pilgrimage P1, P7)

usedBy.smart-trust-demo: Country B: the family's home in journeys J2, J3 and J4.0, whose national portal serves their records abroad in J4.1.
usedBy.pilgrimage: the pilgrim's home country, whose health information exchange signs the pilgrim's summary before travel (smart-ips-pilgrimage).
